_comment: Stacey's factual profile, extracted from Stacey_Doret_CV_Updated (uploaded 2026-09-03). board.py uses this to match listing requirements. Update when the CV changes.
name: Stacey Doret

clinical_exposure.what: Miami Summer Scholars Program, Psychiatry major
clinical_exposure.where: University of Miami / Jackson Behavioral Hospital, Coral Gables & Miami, FL
clinical_exposure.details: Three-week psychiatry and neuroscience enrichment program. Neuropsychological assessments, therapeutic interviewing under a geriatrics specialist, shadowed psychiatrists in outpatient clinics, schizophrenia case discussions.

clinical_exposure.where: Pines Charter Elementary & Pines Middle, Pembroke Pines, FL
clinical_exposure.details: Direct work with children diagnosed with ADHD, ODD, and autism. Administered Dynamic Assessment of Reading. Implemented documented behavioral therapy/intervention plans. Participated in IEP reviews and parent conferences.

clinical_exposure.what: Server, FiveStar Premier Hollywood Retirement Home
clinical_exposure.details: Two-plus years of daily direct contact with elderly residents. Managed up to 16 residents simultaneously; de-escalated complaints. Counts as genuine patient-adjacent geriatric experience.

research.lab: Neuronal Cell Development, Proliferation, and Neurogenesis Lab, Nova Southeastern University
research.topic: Synthetic psychedelic phenethylamines (MDMA, methamphetamine) and their effects on microtubule formation and neurogenesis in human neural progenitor cells

research.pi: Dr. Mark Sobell (PhD, ABPP, ABAP) & Dr. Linda Sobell (PhD)
research.topic: Timeline Followback (TLFB) methodology systematic literature review; contributing to a manuscript in development

research.where: Nova Southeastern University College of Psychology
research.details: Two-week intensive: dissection, experimental design, Drosophila sleep-deprivation study, presented findings to faculty.

teaching.where: Pines Charter Elementary & Pines Middle (NSU Community Practicum, Dr. Razza PsyD)

teaching.role: Guest Lecturer, PSYC 1000 Introduction to Psychology

teaching.where: NSU College of Psychology / Pines Charter High School

employment.where: NSU College of Psychology, Davie, FL
FiveStar Premier Hollywood Retirement Home, Hollywood, FL

presentations_note: 10 SEL presentations delivered at Pines Charter High School and NSU (2022-2023), several as first author: Mindfulness; Overcoming Distractions; Anxiety.

target.name: CNIM / R. EEG T. (ABRET)
target.path: Most South Florida hospitals will train an unlicensed hire into this. Requires accumulating supervised EEG records, then sitting the ABRET exam.
target.blocker: Needs an employer willing to train. This is exactly what the job board is hunting for.

target.name: BLS / CPR (American Heart Association)
target.path: One-day course, roughly $60-90 in Broward. Many clinical postings list it as required.
target.recommendation: Get this before applying. It removes a screening filter from dozens of postings at almost no cost.

gaps_to_watch._comment: Honest weaknesses the board should account for when scoring.
gaps_to_watch.no_eeg_credential: No ABRET registration and no EEG hours yet. Postings requiring R. EEG T. will screen her out unless they explicitly train.
gaps_to_watch.no_bls: No current BLS/CPR card listed on the CV. Fixable in a day.
gaps_to_watch.no_hospital_employment: Clinical exposure is via shadowing and summer programs, not paid hospital employment. Framing matters: the 70 documented shadowing hours and the Jackson Behavioral rotation are the strongest things to lead with.
gaps_to_watch.recent_grad: Graduated December 2024. Postings asking 2+ years of clinical experience are a stretch.
